_note: IT-02: WaitByte / WaitWord / wait counter $08 = n skips n passes and runs on pass n + 1, so it waits n + 1 ticks (actor_execution.asm DEC $08 / BPL, cop_handlers_wait.asm). One spec, ten files plus the town_door comment. Block and part notes use edit ops, so re-running this spec reports an error instead of =unchanged.
